description_en: Checks whether the purchased Security Center features are enabled and whether related configurations take effect
description_zh: 查询已购买的云安全中心产品模块功能是否开启或配置生效
name: GetModuleConfigStatus

parameters.help_en: The service modules that you want to query
parameters.name: module_names

ModuleConfigResults.description_en: The check results of the service modules

items.description_en: The check results of the service module
items.description_zh: 单个产品模块检查结果

ModuleName.description_en:
The name of the check item. Valid values:

Ransom: The anti-ransomware policy is enabled.
WebLock: The web tamper proofing feature is enabled.
Rasp: Applications are added to the application protection feature.
Image: The container images that can be scanned are specified.
Virus: The periodic virus scan policy is enabled
ModuleName.description_zh:
产品模块名称。取值：
Ransom：开启防勒索策略

WebLock：开启网页防篡改功能

Rasp：已创建应用防护配置

Image：已配置容器镜像扫描范围

Virus：开启周期病毒扫描策略

Pass.description_en:
Indicates whether the service module passed the status check. Valid values:

true
false
Pass.description_zh:
产品是否通过状态检查。取值：

true：通过检查，已开启或已配置

false：未通过检查，未开启或未配置

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的 ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
